name: knobs
title: Knobs
description: macOS system switches from Raycast: the grayscale colour filter, lid sleep and caffeinate.
author: c-wenlong

commands.name: set-grayscale
commands.title: Set Grayscale
commands.description: Toggles the grayscale colour filter, or sets its intensity to a given 0-100 level.

commands.name: toggle-lid-sleep
commands.title: Toggle Lid Sleep
commands.description: Toggles whether the Mac stays awake with the lid closed (pmset disablesleep).

commands.name: lid-sleep-status
commands.title: Lid Sleep Status
commands.description: Shows whether the Mac stays awake when the lid is closed.

commands.name: toggle-caffeinate
commands.title: Toggle Caffeinate
commands.description: Starts or stops caffeinate to prevent idle and display sleep.

commands.name: caffeinate-status
commands.title: Caffeinate Status
commands.description: Shows whether caffeinate is currently running.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
